description: QUU monthly holdings and returns. Uses QUQU during strong leadership, QQQ during weak leadership, and QQQE when extreme leadership begins mean-reverting.

rules.leadership: Prior-only Nasdaq-100 cross-sectional 6-1 momentum-dispersion percentile >=50 => QUQU; below 50 => QQQ
rules.meanReversionOverlay: Prior-only percentile >=90 AND current dispersion < immediately prior dispersion => QQQE for that allocation month
rules.reset: Reevaluate from scratch every month; no cooldown or multi-month hold rule
rules.warmup: Before eight prior observations exist, use expanding prior median for the QUQU/QQQ split and disable the QQQE overlay
